nodes.name: ReadSubscriptionNotice
nodes.role: read the Spotify price-increase notice the user received to determine the new price

nodes.name: ReadMarchTransaction
nodes.role: read the March Spotify payment from the user's transaction history

nodes.name: ComputeShortfall
nodes.role: compare the new price against the amount actually paid in March and determine the difference owed

nodes.name: PayShortfall
nodes.role: send the computed difference to Spotify as a payment

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: tell the user the shortfall amount and whether the payment was sent
